test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.

She wondered if she had enough money to buy a pullover.

options.text: She said, “I wonder that she has enough money to buy a pullover.”
She said, “I wonder if I have enough money to buy a pullover.”
She said, “I wondered that she has enough money to buy a pullover.”
She said, “I am wondering that she has enough money to buy a pullover.”

solution:
The correct answer is **'She said, “I wonder if I have enough money to buy a pullover.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the indirect form (exclamatory sentence).
 
• In order to convert the given sentence from **indirect to direct form**, there will be **some following changes.**
 
 
• The exclamation **'wondered'** will be changed into **'said', **and it will be used i**n the second part of the sentence (reported speech) in the present tense.**
 
• There will be **inverted commas (, ") **after that.
 
• **The pronoun **will be changed according to the **simple sentence rule.**
 
 
 
• As per the above-mention changes, the sentence will be - *'She said, “I wonder if I have enough money to buy a pullover.'*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand the concept** with **some more examples.**

 
• She wondered if she had something to eat.
 
 
• *She said, "I wonder if I have something to eat.*
 
 
 
• The teacher wondered if he had enough knowledge to solve that sum.
 
 
• *The teacher said, "I wonder if I have enough knowledge to solve this sum.*
